mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_time_slots (plan_id, slot_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, reserved_count, is_open, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{slotDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, #{reservedCount}, #{isOpen}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_time_slots SET plan_id = #{planId}, slot_date = #{slotDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, capacity = #{capacity}, is_open = #{isOpen}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan_time_slots SET reserved_count = reserved_count + #{delta}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan_time_slots SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
